intent: Record the identity rules a requirements patrol changed or added.
observable_outcome: get-context identity lists the rules as reviewed, each proven by its test.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Once an account purge has claimed the account, it records the account in object storage, outside the database, before it removes any file or row; when that record cannot be written the purge stops and the account and its files stay as they were.

Replaying the purge record registers an erasure for, and purges at once, every recorded account the database holds alive; it leaves accounts already purged and accounts the database does not hold alone, and fails naming any record it cannot read or any account it could not purge.
